2023, amounts balances related to transactions generated with related parties are as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><U>Fiscal years 2019 and 2020</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">As decided by the Board of Directors
in the meeting held on May&nbsp;11, 2020, considering certain case law on the matter assessed by its legal counsel and tax advisors, on
May&nbsp;26 the Bank filed with the Administraci&oacute;n Federal de Ingresos P&uacute;blicos (AFIP, for its acronym in Spanish) its annual
income tax return considering the total effect of the inflation adjustment on income tax (see section a) iv) of Note 21 to the condensed
consolidated interim Financial Statements). As a result, the current income tax determined by the Bank for fiscal year 2019 amounted to
7,002,124 (not restated). The same criterion was applied to determine the annual income tax report for 2020, which generated accrued income
tax for the Bank for such fiscal year that amounted to 9,933,210 (not restated).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">In addition, on July&nbsp;23, 2021,
the Bank filed a reimbursement action with the AFIP requesting that 254,305 (not restated) paid as income tax for the 2020 tax period
be reimbursed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">As to the tax periods mentioned in
previous paragraphs, on November&nbsp;1, 2021, the AFIP notified the beginning of an income tax audit, which is in progress.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">Along with the filings mentioned in
the first paragraph of this section, on December&nbsp;28, 2021, the Bank filed petitions for declaratory judgment with the Federal Administrative
Contentious Court for the periods under analysis. The file 22274/2021, for the fiscal year 2019, is in process in Court No.&nbsp;12 and
the file 22278/2021, for the fiscal year 2020, is in process in Court No.&nbsp;1.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

SA filed a reimbursement action with the AFIP requesting that 382,189 (not restated) paid as income tax for the 2021 tax period be reimbursed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">On January&nbsp;3, 2023, the AFIP notified

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><U>Reimbursement actions &ndash; Fiscal
years 2013 to 2017 and 2018</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">On October&nbsp;24, 2019, Banco Macro
SA filed with the AFIP-DGI (Argentine tax authorities) two reimbursement actions under the terms established by the first paragraph of
section 81, Law No.&nbsp;11683 requesting the reimbursement of 4,782,766 and 5,015,451 (not restated amounts) paid to tax authorities
as income tax during tax periods 2013 through 2017 and 2018, respectively, arising from the impossibility to apply the adjustment for
inflation and other adjustment mechanisms set forth by income tax Law (prior to the amendments introduced by Laws No.&nbsp;27430 and 27468
for periods 2013 through 2017, and as revised in 2019 and amended for the 2018 tax period), plus the related compensatory interest (SIGEA
[case and file management system] files No.&nbsp;19144-14224/2019 and 19144-14222/2019). Since tax authorities have not yet issued a resolution
with respect to the abovementioned claims, on August&nbsp;7, 2020, the Bank filed both reimbursement requests under the terms of section
81, Law No.&nbsp;11683 with the Federal Contentious and Administrative Trial Courts, which are pending in Courts No.&nbsp;8 and 2 of such
jurisdiction, respectively (cases No.&nbsp;11285/2020 and 11296/2020). Currently, in connection with the file for the fiscal year 2018,
the evidence stage is closed and the process for allegation was delivered.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">In connection with the tax periods
mentioned in the previous paragraph, on December&nbsp;19, 2019, the AFIP notified the beginning of the income tax audit for the 2018 tax
period, and on May&nbsp;3, 2021, it notified the beginning of the income tax audit for periods 2013 through 2017. On October&nbsp;4, 2021,
the AFIP ended the audit for periods 2013 through 2017 as the Bank had exercised in due time its right to resort to justice, and that
the admission of reimbursement is subject to a court decision.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><B>26.</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>ADDITIONAL DISCLOSURES IN THE STATEMENT OF CASH FLOWS</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">The Statement of cash flows presents
the changes in cash and cash equivalents derived from operating activities, investing activities and financing activities during the period.
For the preparation of the statement of cash flows the Bank adopted the indirect method for Operating Activities and the direct method
for Investment Activities and Financing Activities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">The Bank considers as &ldquo;Cash and
cash equivalents&rdquo; the item Cash and deposits in banks and those financial assets that are readily convertible to known amounts of
cash and which are subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">For the preparation of the Statement
of cash flows the Bank considered the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">30.1</TD><TD>Financial trusts for investment purposes</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">As of March&nbsp;31, 2024 and December&nbsp;31,
2023, the debt securities with investment purposes and certificate of participation in financial trusts amounted to 1,034,073 and 1,104,626,
respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">According to the latest accounting
information available as of the date of issuance of these condensed separate interim Financial Statements, the corpus assets of the trusts
exceed the carrying amount in the related proportions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
